title: Part Three: Uprising, Oslo, Settlements and Withdrawal

sections.brief: December 1987 in Jabaliya; the uprising's toll in Gaza and overall with competing counts; killings of alleged collaborators; the birth of Hamas, its charter and its 2017 document; the claim of early Israeli tolerance. Figures: stats; comparison.
Oslo in Gaza: the Cairo agreement of May 1994, the PA, Arafat's return, what Israel kept, the Paris Protocol, closures and permits. Figures: timeline; comparison.
Disengagement 2003–2005: votes, evacuation, cost, what Israel retained, the Weisglass interview, and the dispute over whether occupation ended. Figures: timeline; comparison.
